correctness.rationale: The objective is separately convex in x and y, so its maximum over the compact octagonal ball occurs at an extreme-point pair; these vertices lie on the sphere, so this equals the required sphere supremum. An independent direct maximization over all 64 ordered vertex pairs on a 101-point parameter grid agreed with the two claimed branch formulas to numerical roundoff, including the transition m*=(4-sqrt(2))/7 and midpoint value 4-2sqrt(2). The continuum upper bound itself is the exact finite quadratic comparison, not the grid check.

originality.rationale: Originality passes. The 2021 defining paper was read completely: it defines exactly the target unit-sphere parameterized constant and proves general inequalities, but does not compute the regular octagon. The 2024 regular-octagon paper was also read in full; it computes L_YJ and L'_YJ, whose second norm term uses swapped parameter coefficients and is a different functional except at the symmetric midpoint. Its exact regular-octagon formula therefore does not imply the audited two-branch C'_NJ(lambda,X) profile.
